fields.title: Distance matrix column
fields.description:
Select the column containing the distance values. This option is only visible if no distance measure is
connected to Port 1.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Partition count (k)
fields.description: Enter the number of partitions (must be greater than 1).

fields.title: Chunk size
fields.description:
Specify the number of rows to consider at once. This option has no effect on the output but only influences
the runtime (larger chunk size resulting in more memory consumption but faster execution).

fields.title: Constrain number of iterations
fields.description:
Allows limiting the number of iterations to run. If disabled, it will run until the cost reduction is
negative (no better solution available) or the calculation is finished in the view.

fields.title: Use static seed
fields.description:
Seed used for random initialization. The random initialization has no practical impact on the
clustering result (only for theoretical corner cases). If disabled, a "random" random seed is used.

fields.title: Random seed
fields.description:
The seed value used for random initialization. Use the same seed to get identical results across
multiple executions. You can enter a custom value or use the random seed generation button below.

fields.title: Draw seed
fields.description: Generate a random seed and set it in the Random seed input above for reproducible runs.

fields.title: Output relative distances to medoids
fields.description:
If selected, append additional columns to first output table, which reflect the relative distances to each
of the medoids. The smaller the value the higher the membership to the respective partition. The values in
the new columns sum to 1.

fields.title: Choke on asymmetric distances
fields.description:
If selected, the node will fail when the input contains distance vectors that are marked as (potentially)
not symmetric. Asymmetric distances may lead to infinite loops (due to alternating minima). In most cases
you should leave this box selected.
